power_clarification.note: Original sign power counted only thealpha criticalvalue, notminaccuracy orall12components. Strongp90 invariants are adequately powered; p85 jointpower isnotguaranteed. Negativefindings cannot excludeweaker conditionalcoding.

analysis.prediction_scope: FVU predictor receivesoperationalinputfactors andonlydiscoverycellmeans. It isadescriptiveupperbaseline, notamechanismextractor.
analysis.scope: Primary is scoped A-coordinate response invariance acrossallregisteredcode/mapping/split components. Not semanticmonosemanticity, individualnecessity, causalgating orgraph-onlynext-tokenprediction.

analysis_plan.no_automatic_closure: Passing anarrayresponse test upgrades only a scoped response edge. Individual causal use, natural semantics, dictionary andgraph prediction remain separate unknowns.

primary.FWER: Bonferroni across350208units×2readouts. Allcode×mapping×split tests are anintersection-union rule: everycomponent mustpass, no selectionofthebestcomponent.
primary.behavior: everyrelevantcode×mapping×fact×question×frame cellmustpass thefrozen.90 gate. Failedbehavior cannot become a functionalmechanism claim.
primary.contrast: For eachbackground, code andmapping, delta=.5*((A[T=0,Q=0]-A[T=1,Q=0])+(A[T=1,Q=1]-A[T=0,Q=1])). This cancels first-orderfact andquestion terms; equals2*b_TQ.
primary.fit: only discoverylatin_ab, average decision contrast acrossbothmapping orientations andallbackgrounds. signofmean; exactzero signremains0. No CD/甲乙 activation fitted.
primary.heldout: same fixed sign must pass accuracy>=.8, nonzero>=.8, exactone-sidedbinomial p<alpha_per_unit_readout in everycode×mapping ofbothconfirm/lockbox; eachhas192independentbackgrounds.

secondary.factorial: retain ordinary8cell coefficients1,T,Q,M,TQ,TM,QM,TQM for eachcode, split andreadout. G/V/A available asactualdata, no claimofnewalgebra.
secondary.lexical: multiply decision contrast by(-1)^mapping; fit separate discovery signs percode. Descriptive response hypotheses only; no additional FWER-controlledsemantic discoveryclaim.
secondary.parameter_reconstruction: A @ W_down withactualparameter slices versusactualMLP output. Algebraic source checkwithBF16rounding, notcausal necessity.
secondary.prediction: discoverycellmean A predictor, evaluatedperunit onconfirm/lockbox againstdiscoveryglobalmean baseline. Usesoperationalinputfactor annotations, no targetactivation/expectedanswer asinput. Not anindependentmechanism orgraph-onlynext-token model.

conclusion: 9,984条采集及350,208单元检验完成；两个读出响应复现[52489, 50704]，但96个留出行为格有6格失败，功能解释资格为0。响应与功能明确分开。
